name: opengrokbot
description: Local-first Grok Bot-style roster of persistent agents. Unofficial. Bring any OpenAI-compatible API.
author: nickylin

scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n server,electron -c blue,magenta "pnpm dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3088/api/health && electron desktop/main.mjs"
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm build:server && pnpm stage:server && pnpm prepare:icon && pnpm prepare:electron && ELECTRON_BUILDER_HTTP_TIMEOUT=1200000 ELECTRON_BUILDER_BINARIES_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/electron-builder-binaries/ electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
